rows.required: >=1 explanatory visual in every I Do stage and >=2 per lesson
rows.rationale: Measured run 6: 180 of 350 live lessons (51%) carry zero explanatory visuals; estate median 0, maximum 2. All three Humanities families have none.

rows.required: <=1 decorative visual per lesson; decorative never counts toward visuals.explanatory.min
rows.rationale: Without a ceiling the cheapest way to satisfy the row above is to add pictures that explain nothing.

rows.required: no two consecutive lessons in a family share a we-do type; any six consecutive show >=4 types
rows.rationale: Measured run 6: BUILD ASDAN runs 12 consecutive lessons with an identical type-set; three types carry ~85% of all observed we-do activity.

rows.required: the declared we-do type is one of the six
rows.rationale: Discovered from the estate run 6, not imposed. Four are already in use; predict-then-check (3 uses) and spot-the-error (1 use) are included to bring them back. decision-lab is deliberately excluded: it already dominates and the rotation exists to break its grip; it remains the default shape for the independent stage.

Measured runs 4-5: six live lessons run 2.67x-3.75x their family median; two need ~96% of a 40-minute period for reading alone, and the real timetable has no double periods. The 90 wpm rate is an ASSUMPTION - no measured reading rate exists in this repository or the workbooks - and the 60-120 band is carried so no verdict rests on the point estimate.

rows.required: the deck declares its period length and its stage timings sum to it
rows.rationale: All 48 verified surfaces already declare nine stages summing to 40, so this codifies existing practice. It exists so a deck built for a double period says so instead of reading as an overload.

value.addresseeSelector: inside main#lessonDeck (or main.deck), excluding script, style, svg, and any element carrying data-mbm-guide or data-audience="staff". Derived from the tree: run 6's I5 addressee map is not in this repository, and data-mbm-guide is the key the decks actually use.
value.launchDerivation: p25-p75 of live LAUNCH lesson pupil-text FK across all three subjects, n=82, measured this run
value.subjectVocabulary: Subject and framework terms are KEPT and bridged with the estate's .word-bridge lever, never stripped to lower the score.
value.launchFloorWithdrawn: Matt's ruling of 2026-09-02 (ORDER VB-RUN10 D-J). The LAUNCH floor 11.64 is withdrawn: a simpler LAUNCH lesson is never a defect. Only the ceiling 14.21 binds. The pair is kept below because the ceiling is derived from it and g26 still prints the value on every LAUNCH line.
value.reDerivationRule: Re-derive only if the live LAUNCH corpus changes, and stamp the new bandVersion in the same commit.
value.launchAdvisory: The live band 11.64-14.21 is high for Foundation GCSE pupils. That is a fact about the live pack, not a target: new LAUNCH work aims lower where the content allows. Advisory, never gated.

rows.required: pupil-text FK within the pathway band; LAUNCH ceiling-only
rows.binding: binding on new work (LAUNCH: ceiling only); report-only on live

provenance.order: VB run 8 §3.1(d); Matt's ruling H7_1 = PATHWAY-BAND
provenance.note: No live BUILD or GROW lesson is inside its band: BUILD's easiest measures 6.25 against a ceiling of 4.0, GROW's easiest 7.43 against 7.0. The row is scope:new and report-only on live, so nothing is judged retrospectively, but new work will read markedly plainer than the estate around it. Recorded, not smoothed.
provenance.rulingD_J: ORDER VB-RUN10 §2 D-J, 2026-09-02: CEILING-ONLY BINDING at the live p75 14.21; floor withdrawn.

proofRule: Every row has a non-zero literal grep -n -F -o proof against its named donor.
scopeRule: Rows carrying scope:'new' bind only surfaces authored after they landed. Live work is never judged by them. Rows without a scope key are unscoped and bind as before.
